name: Power dressing
region: New York, USA, and Milan, Italy
summary: The working woman's suit of the 1980s. It has a tailored jacket with wide padded shoulders, a skirt or trousers in wool and a silk blouse with a bow. The colour is strong and plain.

philosophy.core_thesis: Dress is a uniform of authority. A woman at work wears the wide shoulder and the sharp line of the man's suit, and so claims the same standing.
design_principles: Pad the shoulder so that it measures 2 to 4 cm wider than the natural shoulder line.
Cut the jacket to the hip, with a nipped waist or a straight box line.
Set the skirt hem at the knee, and cut the trouser straight with a pleat.
Choose a fine worsted wool, gabardine or crepe in a plain colour.
Pair the jacket with a silk blouse, a bow or a shirt, and keep the neck covered.
Match the jacket and the skirt or trouser in one cloth.
Finish with a gold button, a belt, a plain pump and a structured bag.

silhouette.shape: An inverted triangle: a wide, padded shoulder, a narrow waist or straight body and a skirt or trouser that is slim to the knee.
silhouette.line: A strong horizontal shoulder, a hip-length jacket, and a hem at the knee.
silhouette.fit: Close at the waist and the hip; the shoulder stands out from the body on its pad.
silhouette.proportion: Shoulder pad 1 to 2 cm thick; jacket to the top of the thigh; skirt hem at mid-knee; lapel 8 to 10 cm.
rules: Square the shoulder with a pad in the jacket and in the blouse.
Nip the jacket at the waist, or cut it straight in a long box shape.
Keep the skirt slim and at the knee.
Wear a bow or a plain shirt at the neck.
Match the colour of the jacket and the skirt.

fabrics.rule: Choose a fine, firm wool for the suit and a smooth silk for the blouse. The cloth must hold a sharp pad and a pressed crease.

methods: shoulder pad set in the sleeve head
canvas and wadding in the chest
tailored lining with a full inner pocket
pressed pleat and crease in the trouser
silk blouse with a tie neck
construction.closures: A single or double-breasted front with 2 to 6 buttons; a concealed zip on the skirt.
construction.details: Gold buttons, a notched or peak lapel, a pocket flap, a pussy-bow blouse and a slim belt.

surface.pattern: Plain colour, a fine pinstripe or a small check; no loud print.
surface.gloss: Wool at 2–5 GU; silk blouse at 20–40 GU; gold buttons at 80 GU.
surface.wear: The style wants a pressed, new look; a crease or a worn cuff weakens the authority.

palette.strategy: Strong, plain suit colours with a pale blouse: navy, grey, black and a bold red or pink.

processes: designer collections in Milan and New York
making.scale: Designer ready-to-wear and the high street: made in large runs, from the luxury label to the store brand.
making.signs: A crisp pad line, a pressed edge, a lined sleeve and uniform buttons.

pieces.form: Hip-length jacket with wide padded shoulders and gold buttons
Slim knee-length skirt that matches the jacket
Straight pleated trousers with a crease
Silk blouse with a pussy bow and a small shoulder pad
Crisp tailored shirt with a stiff collar

evidence.title: Geraldine Ferraro at the 1984 Democratic National Convention

emotion.target_response: A sense of authority and drive: the viewer sees a sharp, strong shape that says the wearer is in charge.

use_cases: a costume brief for a 1980s office drama
a study note on gender and dress at work
avoid_when: the brief wants a soft or romantic look
the brief is casual, street or sport dress
the brief wants a minimal modern line without a shoulder pad

modifiers.how: Remove the pad and the gold, keep a plain cut in fine wool, and use a narrower shoulder.
Keep the cloth and the cut, drop the wide pad, and use a natural shoulder.
